playstyle: Six fragile Tzeentch cultists and Horrors with low Health, average Move and slower Horror minions. Nearly every fighter carries a range-3 ranged attack, so the warband peppers foes from a distance, with inspired cultists gaining Stagger and the Horrors adding Brutal dice. It has no warscroll of its own and borrows a generic Chaos one, either flooding neutral territory or chasing melee kills, while K'charik's Cleave hammer finishes staggered targets. It wins by trading shots, picking off weakened enemies and outnumbering foes on objectives.
